name: Kanno Hotori
source:
The protagonist of Un:Birthday Song. Hotori is a meek, shy and reserved high school student. Possessing good grades, her hobbies are maternal- such as being good at cooking. She has one-sided feelings for Hayasaka Shizuru, who also attends the same school as her.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/un_birth/chara_hotori.html]official website profile[/URL].]
